overview: The broadcast featured highlights from the Mr. MHS 2017 competition, promotions for the Team HEMO pediatric cancer fundraiser, and a student commentary addressing homelessness.

items.title: Mr. MHS 2017
items.summary: Medford High School hosted the Mr. MHS 2017 contest, which concluded with Devin Bombardo being named the winner.

items.title: Team HEMO Buzz Off Fundraiser
items.summary: Community members and McGlynn Elementary School teacher Anthony Petrelis promoted participation and donations for Team HEMO at the One Mission Buzz Off event for pediatric cancer.

items.title: Student Perspective on Homelessness
items.summary: A student presentation urged compassion, volunteerism, and donations for people experiencing homelessness while reflecting on consumerism.
